disclosure: Fixed stock synthetic voices, exact delivered clips with one-second gaps. Technical audition, not perceptual acceptance.

intervals.speaker: Mara
intervals.direction: Quiet recognition; distinguish company from the delivered envelope.
intervals.text: You paid someone to carry the paper so you could sit here. I remember the chair, too.

intervals.speaker: Mara
intervals.direction: An unpressured boundary; no accusation for declining.
intervals.text: I kept the hour for myself. You don't owe me company because you heard what I did.

intervals.speaker: Mara
intervals.direction: Admit disappointment without withdrawing ownership of her time.
intervals.text: I did this after you left. You took the envelope; I kept the hour. I wanted you here, too. Both things can be true.

intervals.speaker: Mara
intervals.direction: Matter-of-fact delay followed by remembered company.
intervals.text: The envelope went in the next batch. That hour didn't need a receipt to have happened.

intervals.speaker: Mara
intervals.direction: Warmth and unfinished work coexist; do not imply dispatch.
intervals.text: The envelope is still here. I'm glad you sat with me. I still need to send it.

intervals.speaker: Kerr
intervals.direction: Understated acknowledgement, not a reward or treatment claim.
intervals.text: That was the part I asked you to keep.

intervals.speaker: Kerr
intervals.direction: Firm, restrained disappointment; retain the recorded breach.
intervals.text: You wrote my name after promising not to. Don't call this private.

intervals.speaker: Edda
intervals.direction: Practical instruction, then the personal employment cost.
intervals.text: Your export records a cancellation. My ledger can show whether it reached the shift. Compare them. I have to work here tomorrow.

intervals.speaker: Edda
intervals.direction: Clear permission boundary; no implied authorization.
intervals.text: Ask before you put my name on a public copy.

intervals.speaker: Edda
intervals.direction: Businesslike private permission; distinguish work from publication.
intervals.text: I'll sign for payroll to use my name here. Not on your public packet. Leave the witness recording and patient list out. I need a shift, not another version of the accusation.

intervals.speaker: Sera
intervals.direction: Patient distinction between memorial and public evidence.
intervals.text: The names can be spoken either way. This is a different promise: an account someone can question after you leave.

intervals.speaker: Sera
intervals.direction: Direct correction without humiliation or erased consequences.
intervals.text: Correct it here. A correction belongs beside what people already heard.

intervals.speaker: Sera
intervals.direction: Open invitation with the old transaction still acknowledged.
intervals.text: say them. If you sold them, you can still say them. The wall does not check your receipt.

intervals.speaker: Ives
intervals.direction: Controlled institutional challenge; sharpen the final question.
intervals.text: A maintenance signature isn't an issuing key. A witness isn't a server. What exactly are you asking people to believe?

intervals.speaker: Nia Pell
intervals.direction: Deliberate ownership of each limit, not frightened gratitude.
intervals.text: Use the words I approved. You can name me as the source through Sera. No address, no new story about how brave I was, and no sentence saying the room made me owe you this.

intervals.speaker: Sister Lumen
intervals.direction: Measured practical care, no invented clinic outcome.
intervals.text: This buys a way to answer them. I will not mark it as three new appointments.

intervals.speaker: Sister Lumen
intervals.direction: Calm acknowledgement of consequences that persist.
intervals.text: The observer saw the old time. Taking down the paper cannot take that back.

intervals.speaker: Sera
intervals.direction: Ordinary shared work; light invitation after the loss.
intervals.text: The clothes are what they have left. Help me get them clean?
